summary: Implemented Claude route ownership handling, external-readonly downgrade, Feishu question awaiting ACK state machine, local-first handling, late answer protection, timeout classification, and structured redacted logs.

message_dispatcher: Claude /new sessions are persisted with agentRef.owner=walker-managed and inputWritable=true.
Auto-bound or /attach Claude transcript sessions are persisted as agentRef.owner=external-readonly and inputWritable=false without resumeSession.
External-readonly Claude sessions can watch transcript events but prompt/stop/delete write paths do not call resume/write/stop/delete.
Watched Claude tool_use result events with requestID/toolUseId/dedupeKey are routed to QuestionHandler.handleToolResult.
question_handler: Stored question request includes requestID, toolUseId, questions, routeKey, chatId, owner, inputWritable, source, dedupeKey and card ids.
Claude answer submission transitions collecting/submitting to awaiting_tool_result after driver.replyQuestion(..., { questions }).
QuestionHandler.handleToolResult(session, chatId, event) transitions awaiting_tool_result to answered, or collecting to answered_elsewhere.
QuestionHandler.expireAwaitingToolResults() marks stale awaiting requests as unconfirmed_timeout.
Terminal answered/answered_elsewhere/unconfirmed_timeout states ignore late Feishu answers and do not call replyQuestion.
